headline: GE Vernova to Acquire Trench Group for $9 Billion and Raises Forecast
summary: GE Vernova agreed to purchase high-voltage equipment maker Trench Group from Triton Partners for $9 billion. The company raised its 2026 revenue guidance to between $46.5 billion and $47.5 billion amid increased grid spending.
why: GE Vernova is a major energy equipment manufacturer benefiting from global utility investments in power grid modernization and renewable integration.

impacts.name: GE Vernova Inc.
impacts.why: The acquisition expands grid equipment capacity while GE Vernova raised its full-year sales guidance for a third time.

why_moved: GE Vernova shares responded positively to the $9 billion grid equipment acquisition and an upgraded full-year revenue forecast.
